faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our import/export solutions.
faq.q1: How do you ensure product quality?
faq.a1: We conduct multi-stage on-site inspections, factory audits, and pre-shipment checks to ensure every product meets international standards and your specific requirements.
faq.q2: What is the typical minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faq.a2: MOQs vary by industry and manufacturer. However, our strong supplier network allows us to negotiate flexible terms, often facilitating smaller initial orders for new international partners.
faq.q3: Do you handle all logistics and customs?
faq.a3: Yes, we provide end-to-end logistics management. This includes documentation, freight coordination, and customs clearance support to ensure a seamless delivery to your destination.
faq.q4: Can you source products not listed in your catalog?
faq.a4: Absolutely. Our extensive local network allows us to source virtually any high quality Vietnamese product. Just provide us with your specifications, and we'll find the ideal supplier.
faq.q5: What are your standard payment terms?
faq.a5: We typically work with T/T (Telegraphic Transfer) or L/C (Letter of Credit) at sight. Specific terms can be negotiated based on order volume and partnership history.
faq.q6: How long does the sourcing process typically take?
faq.a6: Initial supplier identification usually takes 5–7 business days. Full production cycles depend on the product type and quantity, but we always aim for maximum efficiency.
faq.q7: Do you offer OEM and Private Label services?
faq.a7: Yes, we specialize in helping brands manufacture their own products in Vietnam, providing full support from design compliance to final packaging.
